title: FAANG Patterns
definition: Big tech companies test specific things. Meta tests speed and bug-free execution on Mediums. Google tests obscure Math and advanced Graph/DP Hard problems. Amazon tests Object-Oriented Design and Leadership Principles alongside algorithms.
simpleExplanation: Knowing exactly what the company you are interviewing for cares about.

answers.question: **Basic:** Describe the fundamental approach for FAANG Patterns.
**Intermediate 1:** Add Memoization (Top-Down) to FAANG Patterns to prevent redundant calculations.
**Intermediate 2:** Convert FAANG Patterns into a Tabulation (Bottom-Up) approach.
**Advanced:** Solve a 2D matrix or multi-state problem using FAANG Patterns.
**Expert/FAANG:** Optimize the space complexity of FAANG Patterns from O(N) to O(1) or O(N^2) to O(N).
